overview:
Reflectiz's innovative agentless solution monitors and detects vulnerabilities in all 1st, 3rd, and 4th party applications within your online ecosystem, providing complete visibility into your web risk exposure. It efficiently prioritizes and remediates risks and compliance issues using its proprietary exposure rating system.  

This integration enhances your website's security by introducing **Web Exposure Rating** and **Web Exposure Alerts** in Datadog, enabling proactive assessment and mitigation of security risks.  

The integration provides a combination of logs and metrics to support both ratings and alerts.

### Features

- **Web Exposure Rating**: Gain a clear and comprehensive security rating for your website components. The Reflectiz Rating feature provides an at-a-glance evaluation of your website's security status, helping you understand where you stand and where improvements are needed.
- **Web Exposure Alerts**: Be informed in real time about potential risks and vulnerabilities. The integration generates detailed alerts that notify you of misconfigurations, suspicious activity, and emerging threats so that you can take immediate action.
- **Seamless integration with Datadog**: View both the Reflectiz Rating and Risk Alerts directly within your Datadog environment. This allows you to monitor your website's security alongside performance and infrastructure metrics, all in one centralized platform.
- **Prioritize what matters most**: With the Reflectiz Rating and actionable alerts, you can easily identify and prioritize the most critical risks, focusing your efforts on the areas that need attention the most.
setup:
### In Datadog

1. Navigate to the **Integrations** tab in Datadog.
2. Find the **Reflectiz** tile and click **Install Integration**.
3. Click **Connect Accounts** to start the authorization process, which redirects you to the Reflectiz Platform.

### In the Reflectiz Platform

1. Enter your Reflectiz credentials to access your account.
2. Choose the appropriate license for the integration.

Once this flow is complete, Web Exposure Alerts and Rating data are available within the included dashboards.

### Link Reflectiz sites with hosts

To make your data more efficient and meaningful, you can link each of your Reflectiz sites to a host in Datadog:

1. Open the Datadog [host list][1].
2. Select a host.
3. Add a tag under the **User tag** section. The tag should follow the format `reflectiz.host.site:{domain}`, where `domain` is Reflectiz site you want to link in the format `example.com`.  
If you want to add additional sites to a single host, you can add more tags following the format `reflectiz.host.site.1:{domain}`, `reflectiz.host.site.2:{domain}`, and so on.

Once you complete these steps, all metrics and logs are tagged with the appropriate host.

[1]: /infrastructure

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.overall
metrics.description: The overall security rating for the entire site, combining insights from all evaluated components.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.app
metrics.description: The security rating for the applications running on the site.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.domain
metrics.description: The security rating for the domains associated with the site.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.site
metrics.description: The security rating for the site based on different website structure factors.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.industry_overall
metrics.description: The overall security rating of the site when compared against industry benchmarks.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.industry_app
metrics.description: The average application security rating for websites in the same industry.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.industry_domain
metrics.description: The average security rating for domains within the same industry.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.industry_site
metrics.description: The average security rating for website structures in the same industry.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.app.specific
metrics.description: A detailed security rating for a specific application on the site. Applications can be filtered by the tag `reflectiz.app`.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.domain.specific
metrics.description: A security rating focused on a specific domain associated with the site. Domains can be filtered by the tag `reflectiz.domain`.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.site.specific
metrics.description: A security rating focused on a specific website structure category associated with the site.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.numberOfExternalItem
metrics.description: Tracks the number of external items for each category present on the site. Category can be filtered using the tag `reflectiz.structure.category`.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.rating.industry_numberOfExternalItem
metrics.description: The average number of external items found on websites in the same industry for different categories. Category can be filtered using the tag `reflectiz.structure.category`.

metrics.name: reflectiz.v1.alerts.count
metrics.description: The number of alerts triggered during a specific scan. This metric can be filtered by the tags `reflectiz.site`, `reflectiz.scan`, and `reflectiz.alert.severity`.
